=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text puzzle "850002400720000009004000000000107002305000900040000000000080070017000000000036040"
text tbar "------+-------+------\n"
text tsep "| "
text tsolved "solved:\n"
global grid ulong 81
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note ok says whether digit d may go in cell c: not already in its row, column or 3x3 box
fn ok c ulong d ulong to bool
r = div c 9
k = rem c 9
b = add mul mul div r 3 3 9 mul div k 3 3
for i ulong 9
if eq get grid add mul r 9 i d
ret false
end
if eq get grid add mul i 9 k d
ret false
end
q = add b add mul div i 3 9 rem i 3
if eq get grid q d
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
note solve fills the first empty cell at or after c with each digit that fits and recurses; on a dead
note end it empties the cell again (backtracking); the recursion is at most 81 deep
fn solve c ulong to bool
p = c
while lt p 81 bound 81
if eq get grid p 0
break
end
p = add p 1
end
if eq p 81
ret true
end
for x ulong 9
d = add x 1
if ok p d
put grid p d
if solve add p 1
ret true
end
end
end
put grid p 0
ret false
end
fn show to void
for r ulong 9
if and gt r 0 eq rem r 3 0
emit tbar
end
for k ulong 9
if and gt k 0 eq rem k 3 0
emit tsep
end
emitu get grid add mul r 9 k
if lt k 8
emit sp
end
end
emit nl
end
end
fn main to int
for i ulong 81
put grid i sub ulong get puzzle i 48
end
show
if not solve 0
exit 1
end
emit tsolved
show
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
